title: Eswatini Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and disaster impacts, climate projections, and planned adaptation targets reported in 2025
methodology: National communication summarizes climate trends, scenarios, sector impacts and adaptation priorities.
limitations: Statistics cite other studies; NDC targets are plans, not evaluated outcomes.

title: Drought Resilience Profiles: Eswatini
organization: World Bank, CIWA, SADRI, IWMI and National Drought Mitigation Center
temporal_coverage: Drought impacts and preparedness information summarized in an undated profile
methodology: Brief profile applies an integrated drought-risk-management framework covering monitoring, vulnerability and impacts, and preparedness and response.
limitations: The profile is a concise overview, carries a disclaimer that it may not represent partner organizations' views, and does not constitute an impact evaluation.

title: The Kingdom of Eswatini's Initial Adaptation Communication to the UNFCCC
organization: Government of Eswatini, Ministry of Tourism and Environmental Affairs
temporal_coverage: Government assessment summarizing historic impacts and a 2021 risk profile, with adaptation actions reported through 2021 and some projections to 2050.
methodology: Government UNFCCC submission synthesizing prior risk studies, a 2021 assessment and adaptation activities.
limitations: Dated national self-report; project outcomes are not independently evaluated.

title: Kingdom of Eswatini: Selected Issues
temporal_coverage: Climate-impact chapter reports disaster and agricultural context through 2024 and provincial agricultural stress since 2020.
methodology: IMF staff country analysis using EM-DAT, FAO data and staff calculations, with cited government and partner evidence.
limitations: Short national analysis synthesizes secondary sources; provincial stress chart is relative and does not estimate household-level losses.

title: Effectiveness of climate change adaptation strategies in strengthening food and water security resilience in Eswatini
organization: Lindiwe Maphalala, Denver Naidoo, Unathi Kolanisi and Lelethu Mdoda; Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems
temporal_coverage: Mixed-methods household survey and open-ended responses collected in 2025 in six communities in Lubombo Region; article published 18 August 2026.
methodology: Cross-sectional mixed-methods household survey in six selected Lubombo communities.
limitations: Abstract gives 859 respondents; methods specify an 880 target. Selected cross-sectional sites are not national causal estimates.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Eswatini
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: GIEWS reference date 25 August 2026; reports completed 2026 harvest and food-security projections for October 2026 to March 2027.
methodology: FAO GIEWS brief drawing on cereal balances, earth observation, price monitoring and the latest IPC analysis.
limitations: National food-security assessment and outlook without regional or livelihood-zone breakdown.
